death.attack.mobslayer.blade: %1$s was shredded by a Mob Slayer
death.attack.mobslayer.blade.player: %1$s was shredded by a Mob Slayer
gui.mobslayer.redstone.high.desc: The Mob Slayer only attacks while it receives a redstone signal.
gui.mobslayer.redstone.low.desc: The Mob Slayer only attacks while it receives no redstone signal.
gui.mobslayer.redstone.ignored.desc: The Mob Slayer always attacks, with or without a signal.
gui.mobslayer.upgrades.none: None. Enchant the Mob Slayer like a sword at an enchanting table or with books on an anvil.
gui.mobslayer.upgrades.tooltip: Enchantments work like on a sword:
gui.mobslayer.upgrades.tooltip.damage: Sharpness, Smite, Bane of Arthropods: more damage
gui.mobslayer.upgrades.tooltip.fire: Fire Aspect: sets mobs on fire
gui.mobslayer.upgrades.tooltip.knockback: Knockback: pushes mobs away from the block
gui.mobslayer.xp.tooltip.levels: Enough to go from level 0 to level %s
gui.mobslayer.collect.tooltip: Gives you all stored experience points.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mobslayer: Adds the Mob Slayer: a block that damages mobs in front of it without ammunition, can be switched with redstone, is enchanted like a sword and stores the experience of its kills for you to collect.
config.mobslayer.title: Mob Slayer Settings
config.mobslayer.ui.remote: You are playing on a server: these settings only apply to your own worlds. The server uses its own config/mobslayer.json.
config.mobslayer.ui.map_hint: One entry per line: key = value
config.mobslayer.ui.invalid: Some values are invalid (shown in red).
config.mobslayer.ui.discard.title: Discard changes?
config.mobslayer.ui.discard.message: Your changes to the settings have not been saved.
config.mobslayer.defaultDamage.tooltip: Base damage of a newly placed Mob Slayer (2 = one heart). Players change it per block in its GUI.
config.mobslayer.minDamage.tooltip: Lowest base damage players can set in the GUI.
config.mobslayer.maxDamage.tooltip: Highest base damage players can set in the GUI. Set it to the minimum to fix the damage.
config.mobslayer.attackIntervalTicks.too: Ticks between two attacks (20 = one second). Below 10, a mob that was just hit is still protected by its invulnerability time.
config.mobslayer.reach.tooltip: How many blocks in front of the blade side are attacked.
config.mobslayer.reachPerSweepingEdgeLev: Extra blocks of reach for every level of Sweeping Edge on the block.
config.mobslayer.maxReach.tooltip: Upper limit for the reach, Sweeping Edge included.
config.mobslayer.maxTargetsPerAttack.too: Most mobs hit by one attack, nearest first.
config.mobslayer.damagePlayers.tooltip: Players are only hurt when this is on and PvP is allowed on the server.
config.mobslayer.damageBabyAnimals.toolt: Calves, lambs, piglets, … so breeding pens survive. Baby monsters such as baby zombies are always attacked.
config.mobslayer.excludedEntities.toolti: Entity ids that are never attacked, e.g. minecraft:villager.
config.mobslayer.excludedEntities.hint: One entity id per line, e.g. minecraft:villager
config.mobslayer.xpMultiplier.tooltip: Experience stored per kill, as a factor of what the mob drops when a player kills it.
config.mobslayer.maxStoredXp.tooltip: Most experience points one block stores; 0 = no limit. Anything above the limit drops as orbs.
config.mobslayer.defaultRedstoneMode.too: How a newly placed Mob Slayer reacts to redstone. Players change it per block in its GUI.
config.mobslayer.attackEffects.tooltip: Sweep particles and sound on every attack.
